overview: FEM (Future Expense Manager) is a mobile-first financial advisor web app for middle-class Indian families. It offers lead generation, services directory, SIP calculator, educational articles in Hindi and English, and contact options — all in a clean blue-green design with bottom tab navigation.
features: Lead capture form with Name, Phone, City and callback request
Services directory: Life Insurance, Health Insurance, Mutual Funds, Loan Services
Education articles in Hindi and English
Contact tab with Call, WhatsApp, and contact form
Professional blue and green color scheme
